name: support
summary: Keep unassigned work visible, then compare routing policies against a stated capacity budget.
metricSql: SELECT q.team_name AS group_name, count(*)::text AS records, sum(t.estimated_minutes)::text AS total FROM stellane_demo_support.ticket_log t LEFT JOIN stellane_demo_support.service_queues q ON t.queue_hint=q.queue_key WHERE t.state='open' GROUP BY q.team_name ORDER BY q.team_name NULLS LAST
fingerprintSql: SELECT md5(jsonb_build_object('queues',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(q) ORDER BY queue_key) FROM stellane_demo_support.service_queues q),'tickets',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(t) ORDER BY ticket_no) FROM stellane_demo_support.ticket_log t))::text) AS fingerprint
capacitySql: SELECT q.team_name AS group_name,q.capacity_minutes::text AS capacity,COALESCE(sum(t.estimated_minutes),0)::text AS planned, greatest(COALESCE(sum(t.estimated_minutes),0)-q.capacity_minutes,0)::text AS over_capacity FROM stellane_demo_support.service_queues q LEFT JOIN stellane_demo_support.ticket_log t ON t.queue_hint=q.queue_key AND t.state='open' GROUP BY q.team_name,q.capacity_minutes ORDER BY q.team_name
interpretation: Both policies account for all 6 open tickets / 590 estimated minutes. Policy B fits the supplied toy capacity budgets; this does not prove specialist eligibility, an SLA improvement or a real handling-time reduction.
